newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST-PGS 1996 pre-tax seen 40 pct up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-PGS 1996 pre-tax seen 40 pct up.

text.p: Full-year 1996 pre-tax profits at Norwegian offshore company Petroleum Geo-Services ASA (PGS) are expected to jump nearly 40 percent to around 464 million crowns, according to a Reuter survey of seven analysts.
In the corresponding year-ago period PGS booked profits before tax of 333 million crowns.
All the analysts were agreed that with growth expected to be strong in the seismic sector, PGS' activities were stretegically in the right market in the offshore sector.
But they were not agreed about the company's share price potential.
"The expectations already held in the share price are somewhat exaggerated," said one analyts with a hold recommendation on the stock.
Altogether four analysts gave a hold recommendation, two said buy and one said sell.
PGS will release full-year results on February 12. Following table lists analysts expectations.
